out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. EHS observed numerous fruit flies in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that Clorox wipes were not being properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. The Clorox wipes were being stored next to opened seasoning containers on a metal shelving unit in prep area.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CLOROX WIPES MUST BE STORED AWAY FROM FOOD AND WITH OTHER CHEMICALS. PIC MOVED THE WIPES TO A LOWER SHELF ON THE METAL SHELVING UNIT NEXT TO A SANITIZER BUCKET.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Drain files were seen on the ceiling and around the food prep areas.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT MEASURES SHOULD BE TAKEN IN ORDER CONTROL THE DRAIN FLIES. PIC SHOULD CALL PEST CONTROL TO COME IN BETWEEN SCHEDULED PEST CONTROL APPLICATION APPOINTMENTS.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloth in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): Observed milk crates used to elevate sanitizer, detergent buckets.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. PIC discarded milk crates and moved sanitizer and detergent buckets to the shelves.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw tuna was observed stored above cream cheese on the cooling rack inside the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated cream cheese to an upper shelf above the raw tuna.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): Milk crates were observed being used to elevate food items in the freezer and underneath the prep counter.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. CFM will remove the milk crates and replaced them with approved, easily cleanable shelving units to ensure compliance with food safety and sanitation requirements.
